changes: Renamed Fine Tune + Sample Rate. TUN's plain turn moves 1 cent a step (cents in TUN's own 8.8 word), a pressed turn whole semitones keeping the cents; TUN's row carries stock's fine-lock flag; the value reads with two places, as LFO depth.
After a switch of SMP RATE (tap, row, kit, sound or sound lock) FIN's smoother state takes its value at once for about 0.1 s: no speed dip or pitch slide.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
